name: Execute a complex movement sequence
short_description: Perform a memorised sequence of 20 whole-body movements with consistent timing and control.
self_assessment: I can perform 20 memorised whole-body movements in sequence without help or losing the order.
description: Perform a memorised sequence of 20 whole-body movements with consistent timing and control. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
